summary: Sets GameDeviceObject state 18 via virtual dispatch (vtable+252) with a value selected by a2 and the byte_8B8C48 sound-routing flag. For a2==0 sends value 0; for a2==1 sends 2 if byte_8B8C48 bit 0 is set else 1; other a2 values store without dispatch. Records a2 into this[13] (offset 0x34) unless a2 equals -1 or the previous stored value.

operations.description: Early return when a2 == -1 or a2 equals the previously stored value at this[13] (offset 0x34).
For a2 == 0: dispatch through GameDeviceObject vtable+252 with (device, *this id, state 18, value 0).
For a2 == 1: select dispatch value from byte_8B8C48 bit 0 - 2 when set, 1 when clear.
For a2 == 1: dispatch through GameDeviceObject vtable+252 with (device, *this id, state 18, selected value 2 or 1).
For a2 not in {-1, 0, 1}: result becomes a2 - 1; no dispatch occurs.
Record a2 into this[13] (offset 0x34) after handling.
Return the dispatch result (or a2 - 1 for unhandled values).
